messages:
abby: noticed a ~4% preview vs ledger token delta starting 03:10 UTC after we flipped route_priority. preview is attributing more tokens to preroute. anyone else seeing a mismatch? :eyes:

marta: saw the bump on the preview card. we did a sampling tweak yesterday, could be related.

liam: route-resolver rollout at 03:09. quick probe: preview records contain meta.route_hint = preroute_v2 but ledger rows lack that attr after the join. might be a join-path strip.

nora: makes sense. preview emits pre-join sampling tags; ledger finalizes post-join canonical route. when route_priority changes, preview sampling looks like overcount.

marta: suggestion: emit a shadow attribute "route_version" on both preview and ledger for a 1% sample so we can diff deterministically without changing production accounting. low risk.

abby: +1. plan: 1) add route_version meta on meter events, 2) surface a preview_vs_ledger delta card on metering dashboard, 3) canary 1% for 4h, alert if preview_count/ledger_count > 1.02 for 30m.

liam: shim sketch (Go):
```
meta["route_version"] = ctx.Value("route_version").(string)
if rng.Sample(0.01) { emitMeterEvent(ctx, payload, meta) }
```
feature-flagged.

deploy-bot: staging deploy of feature/route-version-shim succeeded - build 4521 (staging).

nora: also add telemetry counters billing.event.emitted.route_version and billing.preview_vs_ledger.delta_ratio. create alert rule ratio > 1.02 for 30m.

marta: I'll own the shim + dashboard + runbook update. target canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will post results here.

liam: if canary looks clean we should run one-off backfill to populate route_version for last 48h events to help invoice reconciliation. coordinate with invoice-audit/billing-ops.

abby: agreed. ping invoice-audit before backfill. adding runbook triage entry for "preview vs ledger divergence" with new counters and dashboard link. thanks all. :thumbsup:
